question: List the vehicles that underperformed in September
gold_sql: WITH v AS (SELECT t.vehicle_id, ve.plate_number, ve.vehicle_type, SUM(t.distance_km) AS km, SUM(t.distance_km)/SUM(t.fuel_used_l) AS kmpl, SUM(t.idle_min)/SUM(t.duration_min) AS idle_ratio FROM trips t JOIN vehicles ve ON ve.vehicle_id = t.vehicle_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY t.vehicle_id HAVING km >= 300), ta AS (SELECT vehicle_type, SUM(km*1.0)/SUM(km/kmpl) AS type_kmpl FROM v GROUP BY vehicle_type) SELECT v.plate_number FROM v JOIN ta USING (vehicle_type) WHERE v.kmpl < 0.8*ta.type_kmpl OR v.idle_ratio > 0.30

question: How many vehicles are currently in the workshop?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'in_workshop'

question: How many trips did each customer make in July?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' GROUP BY c.name

question: Which 5 drivers had the highest risk score in September?
gold_sql: SELECT d.full_name FROM trips t JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id=t.driver_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY t.driver_id HAVING SUM(t.distance_km) >= 500 ORDER BY (SUM(t.harsh_brake_count)+SUM(t.harsh_accel_count)+2*SUM(t.overspeed_count))*100.0/SUM(t.distance_km) DESC LIMIT 5

question: What is the fuel efficiency of each customer's fleet?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(t.distance_km)/SUM(t.fuel_used_l),2) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Average trip distance by vehicle type
gold_sql: SELECT v.vehicle_type, ROUND(AVG(t.distance_km),2) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.vehicle_type

question: How many vehicles are overdue for their service?
gold_sql: WITH last AS (SELECT m.vehicle_id, m.service_date, m.odometer_km, m.next_service_due_km FROM maintenance m WHERE m.record_id = (SELECT m2.record_id FROM maintenance m2 WHERE m2.vehicle_id = m.vehicle_id ORDER BY m2.service_date DESC, m2.record_id DESC LIMIT 1)), cur AS (SELECT l.vehicle_id, l.next_service_due_km, l.odometer_km + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.distance_km) FROM trips t WHERE t.vehicle_id = l.vehicle_id AND t.trip_date > l.service_date),0) AS cur_odo FROM last l) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cur WHERE cur_odo > next_service_due_km

question: Show monthly fuel spend in AED
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', txn_time), ROUND(SUM(amount_aed),0) FROM fuel_transactions GROUP BY 1

question: Which customer had the most breakdowns this quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM maintenance m JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=m.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE m.service_type='breakdown' AND m.service_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What percentage of driving time was idle for Gulf Fresh Foods last month?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(t.idle_min)*100.0/SUM(t.duration_min),1) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE c.name='Gulf Fresh Foods' AND t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'

question: List the 5 oldest vehicles with their plate numbers and year
gold_sql: SELECT plate_number, year FROM vehicles ORDER BY year ASC, vehicle_id ASC LIMIT 5

question: Total harsh braking events per customer in September
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(t.harsh_brake_count) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY c.name

question: Which vehicles bought much more fuel than they used?
gold_sql: WITH used AS (SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(fuel_used_l) AS u FROM trips GROUP BY vehicle_id), bought AS (SELECT vehicle_id, SUM(litres) AS b FROM fuel_transactions GROUP BY vehicle_id) SELECT v.plate_number FROM used JOIN bought USING (vehicle_id) JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=used.vehicle_id WHERE b > 1.15*u

question: Utilization rate of buses in September
gold_sql: WITH u AS (SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.trip_date) AS d FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN trips t ON t.vehicle_id=v.vehicle_id AND t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' WHERE v.vehicle_type='Bus' AND v.status != 'inactive' GROUP BY v.vehicle_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(d*100.0/30),1) FROM u

question: How much maintenance did we spend on tyres in total?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cost_aed),0) FROM maintenance WHERE service_type='tyre'

question: Weekly overspeeding events across all fleets
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-W%W', trip_date), SUM(overspeed_count) FROM trips GROUP BY 1

question: Which drivers work for Coastal Couriers and have more than 15 years of licence?
gold_sql: SELECT d.full_name FROM drivers d JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=d.customer_id WHERE c.name='Coastal Couriers' AND d.license_years > 15

question: What is the cost per km for Emirates Build Co this quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(((SELECT SUM(f.amount_aed) FROM fuel_transactions f JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=f.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE c.name='Emirates Build Co') + (SELECT SUM(m.cost_aed) FROM maintenance m JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=m.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE c.name='Emirates Build Co' AND m.service_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30')) / (SELECT SUM(t.distance_km) FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=v.customer_id WHERE c.name='Emirates Build Co'),3)

question: Top 3 makes by total distance driven
gold_sql: SELECT v.make FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id GROUP BY v.make ORDER BY SUM(t.distance_km) DESC LIMIT 3

question: What was the highest speed recorded in September and by which vehicle?
gold_sql: SELECT v.plate_number, t.max_speed_kmh FROM trips t JOIN vehicles v ON v.vehicle_id=t.vehicle_id WHERE t.trip_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' ORDER BY t.max_speed_kmh DESC LIMIT 1

question: Average fuel price per litre by station city
gold_sql: SELECT station_city, ROUND(SUM(amount_aed)/SUM(litres),3) FROM fuel_transactions GROUP BY station_city
